name: Dark Carnival
source:
They said the carnival was different after dark. I wanted to see if that was true. But which attraction should I visit first?

 [From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/darkcarnival.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
translation:
他們說，天黑後的嘉年華不一樣。我想親眼看看這是否屬實。但我應該先去體驗哪一項遊樂設施？
